## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`
  gates drift.
- Bundled Codex model catalog
  (`lib/src/providers/chatgpt_codex_models_data.dart`) is generated from
  `codex-rs/models-manager/models.json` via
  `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Re-run the script when
  codex-rs ships a new catalog so the picker / OAuth default stay current
  without a manual edit.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,

# Note: n_0994_d128

flutter_app's engine-dependent tests (test/apps/**, gated by native_test_guard.dart's quickJsBridgeAvailable) CAN run on a bare Linux CI runner: flutter_js quickjs/ffi.dart honors LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH when FLUTTER_TEST=true. Set LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH=<pub-cache>/git/flutter_js-*/linux/shared/libquickjs_c_bridge_plugin.so (the .so ships inside the flutter_js git package, not on the loader path). Without it those suites silently SKIP — a fix to js_app_view/js_app_engine can look green while its behavioral coverage never ran.

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`
  gates drift.
- Bundled Codex model catalog
  (`lib/src/providers/chatgpt_codex_models_data.dart`) is generated from
  `codex-rs/models-manager/models.json` via
  `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Re-run the script when
  codex-rs ships a new catalog so the picker / OAuth default stay current
  without a manual edit.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

# Note: n_0994_d128

flutter_app's engine-dependent tests (test/apps/**, gated by native_test_guard.dart's quickJsBridgeAvailable) CAN run on a bare Linux CI runner: flutter_js quickjs/ffi.dart honors LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH when FLUTTER_TEST=true. ## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`
  gates drift.
- Bundled Codex model catalog
  (`lib/src/providers/chatgpt_codex_models_data.dart`) is generated from
  `codex-rs/models-manager/models.json` via
  `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Re-run the script when
  codex-rs ships a new catalog so the picker / OAuth default stay current
  without a manual edit.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —

Common things memory already covers for this repo: worktree placement,
shared-checkout rules, agent messaging fabric, known fragile files,

before you start.

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`
  gates drift.
- Bundled Codex model catalog
  (`lib/src/providers/chatgpt_codex_models_data.dart`) is generated from
  `codex-rs/models-manager/models.json` via
  `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Re-run the script when
  codex-rs ships a new catalog so the picker / OAuth default stay current
  without a manual edit.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`
  gates drift.
- Bundled Codex model catalog
  (`lib/src/providers/chatgpt_codex_models_data.dart`) is generated from
  `codex-rs/models-manager/models.json` via
  `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Re-run the script when
  codex-rs ships a new catalog so the picker / OAuth default stay current
  without a manual edit.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`
  gates drift.
- Bundled Codex model catalog
  (`lib/src/providers/chatgpt_codex_models_data.dart`) is generated from
  `codex-rs/models-manager/models.json` via
  `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Re-run the script when
  codex-rs ships a new catalog so the picker / OAuth default stay current
  without a manual edit.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —

History:
- The test with "no voxelWorld is wired" reason came in at 8bddc479a (11:12).
- The `engine start` AppLog line came from main (01553519a, gh-1336, merged via 295313cb8 "Merge branch 'main'" at ~16:56-17:01).

So the test was GREEN when written (before the main merge — the engine-start log line didn't exist yet), and the merge of main (gh-1336's `engine start` log line) broke it. Classic merge-regression. The WIP auto-saves after the merge (16:56, 17:01, 17:06) only reformatted — nobody re-ran the suite after the merge brought in the log line. This confirms: real regression introduced by the main merge, currently red on any live bridge.

TDD: RED is established (two failing runs above). Now GREEN: the test must assert the diagnostic never fired, not that the buffer is empty. Minimal change: filter the dump for the diagnostic's unique phrase.

The exact diagnostic text from js_app_engine.dart:
```
'WARNING: ${app.id}/$entryFile: voxel node in the rendered tree but '
    'no voxelWorld is wired — the bridge world is missing on this '
    'engine (minimal backend?); the "Voxel world" placeholder is host '
    'wiring, not a broken widget',
```

Note: AppLog joins message with line breaks? `AppLog.i` creates ONE line: `'<ts> [apps] WARNING: voxel-wired/widget.js: voxel node in the rendered tree but no voxelWorld is wired — ...'` — the Dart adjacent-string concatenation produces a single string with no newlines (the continuations are concatenated, no \n). So one line containing "no voxelWorld is wired".

Fix:
```dart
final dumped = AppLog.dump();
final fired = dumped
    .split('\n')
    .where((line) => line.contains('no voxelWorld is wired'))
    .toList();
expect(
  fired,
  isEmpty,
  reason:
      'shipped backends always own a bridge world — the '
      '"no voxelWorld is wired" WARNING must never fire on them '
      '(gh-1441 AC3 contract)',
);
```

Also the two earlier `isEmpty` assertions (never-started, disposed) — those still hold (no engine start line logged since engine never started... wait: 'null after dispose without a start (never-started engine)' test at line 84: `engine(env, 'voxel-disposed-gap'); await e.dispose();` — dispose without start. Also — the test name says "re-armed across restarts". The restart leg: after `e.start()` again, `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(voxelTree)` — with the re-arm + live wired world, still silent. The filtered assertion covers both legs.

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`
  gates drift.
- Bundled Codex model catalog
  (`lib/src/providers/chatgpt_codex_models_data.dart`) is generated from
  `codex-rs/models-manager/models.json` via
  `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Re-run the script when
  codex-rs ships a new catalog so the picker / OAuth default stay current
  without a manual edit.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;

Common things memory already covers for this repo: worktree placement,
shared-checkout rules, agent messaging fabric, known fragile files,
prior false-blame incidents. If the task touches one of those, search
before you start.

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`
  gates drift.
- Bundled Codex model catalog
  (`lib/src/providers/chatgpt_codex_models_data.dart`) is generated from
  `codex-rs/models-manager/models.json` via
  `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Re-run the script when
  codex-rs ships a new catalog so the picker / OAuth default stay current
  without a manual edit.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

The exact diagnostic text from js_app_engine.dart:
```
'WARNING: ${app.id}/$entryFile: voxel node in the rendered tree but '
    'no voxelWorld is wired — the bridge world is missing on this '
    'engine (minimal backend?); the "Voxel world" placeholder is host '
    'wiring, not a broken widget',
```

Note: AppLog joins message with line breaks? `AppLog.i` creates ONE line: `'<ts> [apps] WARNING: voxel-wired/widget.js: voxel node in the rendered tree but no voxelWorld is wired — ...'` — the Dart adjacent-string concatenation produces a single string with no newlines (the continuations are concatenated, no \n).
```dart
final dumped = AppLog.dump();

    .split('\n')
    .where((line) => line.contains('no voxelWorld is wired'))
    .toList();

      '(gh-1441 AC3 contract)',
);
```

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`
  gates drift.
- Bundled Codex model catalog
  (`lib/src/providers/chatgpt_codex_models_data.dart`) is generated from
  `codex-rs/models-manager/models.json` via
  `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Re-run the script when
  codex-rs ships a new catalog so the picker / OAuth default stay current
  without a manual edit.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

The WIP auto-saves after the merge (16:56, 17:01, 17:06) only reformatted — nobody re-ran the suite after the merge brought in the log line. This confirms: real regression introduced by the main merge, currently red on any live bridge.

TDD: RED is established (two failing runs above). Now GREEN: the test must assert the diagnostic never fired, not that the buffer is empty. Minimal change: filter the dump for the diagnostic's unique phrase.

The exact diagnostic text from js_app_engine.dart:
```
'WARNING: ${app.id}/$entryFile: voxel node in the rendered tree but '
    'no voxelWorld is wired — the bridge world is missing on this '
    'engine (minimal backend?); the "Voxel world" placeholder is host '
    'wiring, not a broken widget',
```

Note: AppLog joins message with line breaks? `AppLog.i` creates ONE line: `'<ts> [apps] WARNING: voxel-wired/widget.js: voxel node in the rendered tree but no voxelWorld is wired — ...'` — the Dart adjacent-string concatenation produces a single string with no newlines (the continuations are concatenated, no \n). So one line containing "no voxelWorld is wired".

Fix:
```dart
final dumped = AppLog.dump();
final fired = dumped
    .split('\n')
    .where((line) => line.contains('no voxelWorld is wired'))
    .toList();
expect(
  fired,
  isEmpty,
  reason:
      'shipped backends always own a bridge world — the '
      '"no voxelWorld is wired" WARNING must never fire on them '
      '(gh-1441 AC3 contract)',
);
```

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`
  gates drift.
- Bundled Codex model catalog
  (`lib/src/providers/chatgpt_codex_models_data.dart`) is generated from
  `codex-rs/models-manager/models.json` via
  `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Re-run the script when
  codex-rs ships a new catalog so the picker / OAuth default stay current
  without a manual edit.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

Common things memory already covers for this repo: worktree placement,
shared-checkout rules, agent messaging fabric, known fragile files,
prior false-blame incidents. If the task touches one of those, search
before you start.

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`
  gates drift.
- Bundled Codex model catalog
  (`lib/src/providers/chatgpt_codex_models_data.dart`) is generated from
  `codex-rs/models-manager/models.json` via
  `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Re-run the script when
  codex-rs ships a new catalog so the picker / OAuth default stay current
  without a manual edit.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook

Your option 3 (directory-wide) was chosen; the three-file map survives only as a `knownSurfaces` **floor** — if a known surface stops being visible to the scan (file moved/renamed, scanner broken) the run goes RED with a "fix the guard before trusting a green run" reason instead of turning vacuously green.
3. **Failing sites are reported as `path:line`** computed from a length-preserving masked source, so the numbers are valid against the real file.

## ⚠️ IMPORTANT: AC4 golden — delivered as the suggested fixture-based golden

- `flutter_app/test/golden/apps_golden_test.dart` (`voxel node renders its bridge-owned world, not the placeholder (gh-1441 AC4)`) builds `JsonWidgetRenderer` with a **hand-fed `JsVoxelWorld`** — the exact `voxel.attach` / `voxel.mesh` / `voxel.camera` hostCall payloads a real engine's bridge world receives — **no engine and no native JS bridge**: fully deterministic, runs on any host.

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`
  gates drift.
- Bundled Codex model catalog
  (`lib/src/providers/chatgpt_codex_models_data.dart`) is generated from
  `codex-rs/models-manager/models.json` via
  `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Re-run the script when
  codex-rs ships a new catalog so the picker / OAuth default stay current
  without a manual edit.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script
(`ci_fast_gate.sh --dry-run` in the `changes` job). One classifier, one
set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,
flutter analyze+tests;
scripts/.github/crap4dart.yaml/unknown → everything (safe default, E2 —
holds in CI too). Hook-only extras: dart format self-heal of staged files
and `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` (skipped for docs-only commits).

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in

   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.

   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.

   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`
  gates drift.
- Bundled Codex model catalog

  `codex-rs/models-manager/models.json` via
  `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Re-run the script when
  codex-rs ships a new catalog so the picker / OAuth default stay current
  without a manual edit.

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done right:

1. **Coverage first.** New widget file → tests in
   `test/golden/<area>_golden_test.dart` + map entry in
   `golden_guard_test.dart` (hard-fails otherwise). Changed visuals →
   regenerate affected snapshots.
2. **Real fonts.** `setUpAll(ensureGoldenFonts)` in every golden file;
   placeholder-box glyphs = garbage, redo.
3. **Full frames.** Snapshots are marketing material: full app frames
   (`goldenSizeDesktop` 1280x800, `goldenSizePhone` 390x844) with realistic
   content — never a widget floating on black void.
4. **Determinism.** Fixed data/timestamps, existing-test fakes, no
   network/engines/infinite animations.
5. **Eyes on pixels.** After `--update-goldens`, OPEN every changed PNG
   (no tofu, no overflow, legible buttons/icons) before committing.
6. **Green gate.** `flutter test test/golden` passes; pre-commit runs it +
   `scripts/check_goldens.py` (which also hard-fails on ORPHAN snapshots —
   committed PNGs no test references; delete stale files, never let them
   rot in git history).

## Prompts live outside Dart code

- Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (example app:
  `flutter_app/prompts/`). Never prompt string literals in `.dart` files.
- Format: YAML frontmatter (`name`, `description`) between `---` lines,
  then body; runtime placeholders are `{{name}}` tokens.
- After editing a prompt: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites
  `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` + `flutter_app/lib/prompts.g.dart`
  (generated, never edit by hand); `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart`
  gates drift.
- Bundled Codex model catalog
  (`lib/src/providers/chatgpt_codex_models_data.dart`) is generated from
  `codex-rs/models-manager/models.json` via

  codex-rs ships a new catalog so the picker / OAuth default stay current
  without a manual edit.

Issue #177 restructured CI so a PR pays only for what it touched. The hook
is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI is NOT the same
process — it implements the same stages as parallel jobs, and since
issue #194 its PR path classification runs through the SAME script

set of thresholds; parity is checkable by diffing the hook's
`GATE_STAGE <name> OK|SKIP` markers against the stages the CI changes job
logs for the same diff. Path filters: docs/markdown/prompts-only →
size+analyze; lib/bin/test/example/pubspec → +tests, coverage, CRAP,
jscpd + cross-module dupx; `test/integration/**` → + `integration-mock`
(issue #551: the no-key legs run per-PR); flutter_app/packages → +dupx,

# gh-1441 rework — all open review threads addressed and verified green on the live bridge

## Issues/Notes

- The two open review threads (the automated `REQUEST_CHANGES` review and its gh-807 verdict record) were re-verified finding-by-finding against the current head. The BLOCKING finding (unwired third `JsonWidgetRenderer` site in `app_tile_host.dart` + a guard that scanned 2 of 3 sites), the IMPORTANT AC4-golden gap, and two of the three suggestions were already resolved on this branch; this rework pass **verified each fix** and found + fixed one genuine red the review rounds could not have seen (see below).
- **New fix in this pass:** `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` was RED at head — `a LIVE shipped-backend engine with a wired world never fires the diagnostic — re-armed across restarts` failed. The test asserted `AppLog.dump(), isEmpty`, but main's gh-1336 (`01553519a`, merged into this branch) added a legitimate `engine start: <app>/<entry>` INFO line on every boot, so the assertion could never hold on a live bridge (Linux QuickJS here, the CI macOS exzone leg). The test now asserts the **diagnostic** never fired (filters the dump for the unique `no voxelWorld is wired` phrase) — the AC3 contract itself is unchanged and still pinned. The two `isEmpty` assertions in never-started/disposed paths legitimately hold (no boot → no log lines) and stay as-is.
- Runner note (no repo change): `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` declares the gitignored `.env` asset; `flutter test` cannot build the asset bundle without it — created an empty `.env` locally to run the suites.
- Skipped as time-consuming (documented in PR + test headers, unchanged): ticket edge cases E3 (two-engine cross-talk), E5 (`jsr.capture` golden), and the REG-2 web-worker backend leg (upstream-owned, not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING — third renderer site:** `flutter_app/lib/apps/app_tile_host.dart:407` passes `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` and reports a null world on a voxel tree via `engine.noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)` (`app_tile_host.dart:412`), mirroring the other two surfaces. A tree-wide grep finds exactly three `JsonWidgetRenderer(` sites in `flutter_app/lib` — all three wired.
- **BLOCKING — guard completeness:** `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` scans **every** `.dart` file under `flutter_app/lib` (`rendererRoot`) and asserts every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` passes `voxelWorld:` — the reviewer's directory-wide option, so a fourth site can never silently escape. The known three files survive as a `knownSurfaces` floor: if one stops being visible to the scan (moved/renamed file, broken scanner), the run goes RED with a "fix the guard before trusting a green run" reason instead of turning vacuously green. Failures report `path:line` computed from a length-preserving masked source.
- **IMPORTANT — AC4 golden:** fixture-based golden exactly as the review suggested — `flutter_app/test/golden/apps_golden_test.dart` builds the renderer with a **hand-fed `JsVoxelWorld`** (the exact `voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh`/`voxel.camera` hostCall payloads a real engine's bridge world receives), no engine and no native JS bridge, deterministic on any host. Snapshot `test/golden/goldens/apps_voxel_world.png` committed; the test additionally pixel-probes the captured subtree for both camera sky and painted chunk geometry (an all-sky frame — the gh-1441 bug class — fails the run). `golden_guard_test.dart` resolves it via the existing `lib/apps/js_app_view.dart → apps_golden_test.dart` coverage entry + on-disk snapshot check; `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` confirms no orphan PNG.
- **SUGGESTION — one-shot diagnostic:** adopted as sketched — `js_app_engine.dart:440` re-arms `_unwiredVoxelNoted` in `_start()`; `js_app_engine.dart:400` requires a live engine with a null world. The boot/restart gap can no longer fire (or spend) the diagnostic; every fresh boot re-arms it. Pinned behaviorally (boot-gap silent, disposed silent, live-backend silent across restarts) and statically (the root guard asserts both code shapes).
- **SUGGESTION — scanner hardening:** `maskedForScan` tracks `'` and `"` (plus `'''`/`"""`), raw strings, `\` escapes, and `//` + `/* … */` comments, masking interiors while preserving length/newlines; `balancedArgs` runs on masked text. Accepted-input contract documented (failure direction: false RED, never false GREEN); 7 scanner unit pins added.

## Files Modified

- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — this pass (+10/−1, commit `ad392ded9`): the AC3 live-backend test asserts the diagnostic never fired instead of an empty `AppLog` buffer (merge-window fix, RED→GREEN proven on the live QuickJS bridge).
- Already on the branch and verified by this pass (the PR's 11-file diff): `flutter_app/lib/apps/{js_app_engine,js_app_view,dynamic_widget_tile,app_tile_host}.dart`, `flutter_app/test/apps/{js_app_engine_voxel_world,js_app_view_voxel,dynamic_widget_tile_voxel}_test.dart`, `flutter_app/test/golden/apps_golden_test.dart`, `flutter_app/test/golden/goldens/apps_voxel_world.png`, `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart`.

## Test Coverage

- `dart test test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (root REG-1 guard): **7/7 passed** — includes the new scanner-hardening group.
- `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` (the CI exzone surface, live QuickJS via `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`): **545 passed, 0 failed** — the RED live-backend test above fails without the fix and passes with it (TDD RED→GREEN).
- `flutter test test/golden/golden_guard_test.dart`: **3/3 passed**; voxel golden (`apps_voxel_world`) **passed** pixel-exact on this runner; `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick`: snapshots present, no orphans.
- `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings` (flutter_app): exit 0, **0 errors**; no analyzer issues in any file this PR touches (107 infos, all pre-existing in unrelated files).

{"content":"# gh-1441 rework — all open review threads addressed and verified green on the live bridge

## Issues/Notes

- The two open review threads (the automated `REQUEST_CHANGES` review and its gh-807 verdict record) were re-verified finding-by-finding against the current head. The BLOCKING finding (unwired third `JsonWidgetRenderer` site in `app_tile_host.dart` + a guard that scanned 2 of 3 sites), the IMPORTANT AC4-golden gap, and two of the three suggestions were already resolved on this branch; this rework pass **verified each fix** and found + fixed one genuine red the review rounds could not have seen (see below).
- **New fix in this pass:** `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` was RED at head — `a LIVE shipped-backend engine with a wired world never fires the diagnostic — re-armed across restarts` failed. The test asserted `AppLog.dump(), isEmpty`, but main's gh-1336 (`01553519a`, merged into this branch) added a legitimate `engine start: <app>/<entry>` INFO line on every boot, so the assertion could never hold on a live bridge (Linux QuickJS here, the CI macOS exzone leg). The test now asserts the **diagnostic** never fired (filters the dump for the unique `no voxelWorld is wired` phrase) — the AC3 contract itself is unchanged and still pinned. The two `isEmpty` assertions in never-started/disposed paths legitimately hold (no boot → no log lines) and stay as-is.
- Runner note (no repo change): `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` declares the gitignored `.env` asset; `flutter test` cannot build the asset bundle without it — created an empty `.env` locally to run the suites.
- Skipped as time-consuming (documented in PR + test headers, unchanged): ticket edge cases E3 (two-engine cross-talk), E5 (`jsr.capture` golden), and the REG-2 web-worker backend leg (upstream-owned, not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING — third renderer site:** `flutter_app/lib/apps/app_tile_host.dart:407` passes `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` and reports a null world on a voxel tree via `engine.noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)` (`app_tile_host.dart:412`), mirroring the other two surfaces. A tree-wide grep finds exactly three `JsonWidgetRenderer(` sites in `flutter_app/lib` — all three wired.
- **BLOCKING — guard completeness:** `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` scans **every** `.dart` file under `flutter_app/lib` (`rendererRoot`) and asserts every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` passes `voxelWorld:` — the reviewer's directory-wide option, so a fourth site can never silently escape. The known three files survive as a `knownSurfaces` floor: if one stops being visible to the scan (moved/renamed file, broken scanner), the run goes RED with a "fix the guard before trusting a green run" reason instead of turning vacuously green. Failures report `path:line` computed from a length-preserving masked source.
- **IMPORTANT — AC4 golden:** fixture-based golden exactly as the review suggested — `flutter_app/test/golden/apps_golden_test.dart` builds the renderer with a **hand-fed `JsVoxelWorld`** (the exact `voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh`/`voxel.camera` hostCall payloads a real engine's bridge world receives), no engine and no native JS bridge, deterministic on any host. Snapshot `test/golden/goldens/apps_voxel_world.png` committed; the test additionally pixel-probes the captured subtree for both camera sky and painted chunk geometry (an all-sky frame — the gh-1441 bug class — fails the run). `golden_guard_test.dart` resolves it via the existing `lib/apps/js_app_view.dart → apps_golden_test.dart` coverage entry + on-disk snapshot check; `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` confirms no orphan PNG.
- **SUGGESTION — one-shot diagnostic:** adopted as sketched — `js_app_engine.dart:440` re-arms `_unwiredVoxelNoted` in `_start()`; `js_app_engine.dart:400` requires a live engine with a null world. The boot/restart gap can no longer fire (or spend) the diagnostic; every fresh boot re-arms it. Pinned behaviorally (boot-gap silent, disposed silent, live-backend silent across restarts) and statically (the root guard asserts both code shapes).
- **SUGGESTION — scanner hardening:** `maskedForScan` tracks `'` and `"` (plus `'''`/`"""`), raw strings, `\` escapes, and `//` + `/* … */` comments, masking interiors while preserving length/newlines; `balancedArgs` runs on masked text. Accepted-input contract documented (failure direction: false RED, never false GREEN); 7 scanner unit pins added.

## Files Modified

- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — this pass (+10/−1, commit `ad392ded9`): the AC3 live-backend test asserts the diagnostic never fired instead of an empty `AppLog` buffer (merge-window fix, RED→GREEN proven on the live QuickJS bridge).

The test asserted `AppLog.dump(), isEmpty`, but main's gh-1336 (`01553519a`, merged into this branch) added a legitimate `engine start: <app>/<entry>` INFO line on every boot, so the assertion could never hold on a live bridge (Linux QuickJS here, the CI macOS exzone leg). ## Approach

- **BLOCKING — third renderer site:** `flutter_app/lib/apps/app_tile_host.dart:407` passes `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` and reports a null world on a voxel tree via `engine.noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)` (`app_tile_host.dart:412`), mirroring the other two surfaces. A tree-wide grep finds exactly three `JsonWidgetRenderer(` sites in `flutter_app/lib` — all three wired.
- **BLOCKING — guard completeness:** `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` scans **every** `.dart` file under `flutter_app/lib` (`rendererRoot`) and asserts every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` passes `voxelWorld:` — the reviewer's directory-wide option, so a fourth site can never silently escape. The known three files survive as a `knownSurfaces` floor: if one stops being visible to the scan (moved/renamed file, broken scanner), the run goes RED with a "fix the guard before trusting a green run" reason instead of turning vacuously green. Failures report `path:line` computed from a length-preserving masked source.
- **IMPORTANT — AC4 golden:** fixture-based golden exactly as the review suggested — `flutter_app/test/golden/apps_golden_test.dart` builds the renderer with a **hand-fed `JsVoxelWorld`** (the exact `voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh`/`voxel.camera` hostCall payloads a real engine's bridge world receives), no engine and no native JS bridge, deterministic on any host. - **SUGGESTION — one-shot diagnostic:** adopted as sketched — `js_app_engine.dart:440` re-arms `_unwiredVoxelNoted` in `_start()`; `js_app_engine.dart:400` requires a live engine with a null world. The boot/restart gap can no longer fire (or spend) the diagnostic; every fresh boot re-arms it. Pinned behaviorally (boot-gap silent, disposed silent, live-backend silent across restarts) and statically (the root guard asserts both code shapes).
- **SUGGESTION — scanner hardening:** `maskedForScan` tracks `'` and `"` (plus `'''`/`"""`), raw strings, `\` escapes, and `//` + `/* … */` comments, masking interiors while preserving length/newlines; `balancedArgs` runs on masked text.
