# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1445
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1445
- **Title**: gh-1441 Voxel nodes render as the “Voxel world” placeholder — Fa app builds JsonWidgetRenderer without voxelWorld (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1441` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +1276
- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T11:45:40Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T18:53:50Z

## PR Description

Closes #1441
### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS (`LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`), run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.
- Regression sweep on this runner: `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` → **543 passed, 0 failed** (the CI exzone surface, engines live); the diff's importing suites (`test/golden`, `app_launcher_screen_test`, `chat_screen_test`, `analytics_guard_test`) → 41 passed; full `flutter_app` suite failures (222) are byte-identical on the pre-fix baseline commit and confined to the host-locked golden suite (220 — documented ubuntu-excluded in `ci.yml`) plus 2 env-bound legs (wasm shell scripting, OAuth port binding) in suites this diff never touches. `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`: no issues in changed files.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

The previous pass added code to `js_app_engine.dart` (`_containsVoxelNode` recursion, `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld`) and `apps_golden_test.dart`... but lib files are the scope.

## Issues/Notes

- The two open review threads (the automated `REQUEST_CHANGES` review and its gh-807 verdict record) were re-verified finding-by-finding against the current head. The BLOCKING finding (unwired third `JsonWidgetRenderer` site in `app_tile_host.dart` + a guard that scanned 2 of 3 sites), the IMPORTANT AC4-golden gap, and two of the three suggestions were already resolved on this branch; this rework pass **verified each fix** and found + fixed one genuine red the review rounds could not have seen (see below).
- **New fix in this pass:** `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` was RED at head — `a LIVE shipped-backend engine with a wired world never fires the diagnostic — re-armed across restarts` failed. The test asserted `AppLog.dump(), isEmpty`, but main's gh-1336 (`01553519a`, merged into this branch) added a legitimate `engine start: <app>/<entry>` INFO line on every boot, so the assertion could never hold on a live bridge (Linux QuickJS here, the CI macOS exzone leg). The test now asserts the **diagnostic** never fired (filters the dump for the unique `no voxelWorld is wired` phrase) — the AC3 contract itself is unchanged and still pinned. The two `isEmpty` assertions in never-started/disposed paths legitimately hold (no boot → no log lines) and stay as-is.
- Runner note (no repo change): `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` declares the gitignored `.env` asset; `flutter test` cannot build the asset bundle without it — created an empty `.env` locally to run the suites.
- Skipped as time-consuming (documented in PR + test headers, unchanged): ticket edge cases E3 (two-engine cross-talk), E5 (`jsr.capture` golden), and the REG-2 web-worker backend leg (upstream-owned, not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING — third renderer site:** `flutter_app/lib/apps/app_tile_host.dart:407` passes `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` and reports a null world on a voxel tree via `engine.noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)` (`app_tile_host.dart:412`), mirroring the other two surfaces. - **Title**: gh-1441 Voxel nodes render as the “Voxel world” placeholder — Fa app builds JsonWidgetRenderer without voxelWorld (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1441` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11

- **Deletions**: -3

- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T18:53:50Z

## PR Description

Closes #1441
### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS (`LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`), run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.
- Regression sweep on this runner: `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` → **543 passed, 0 failed** (the CI exzone surface, engines live); the diff's importing suites (`test/golden`, `app_launcher_screen_test`, `chat_screen_test`, `analytics_guard_test`) → 41 passed; full `flutter_app` suite failures (222) are byte-identical on the pre-fix baseline commit and confined to the host-locked golden suite (220 — documented ubuntu-excluded in `ci.yml`) plus 2 env-bound legs (wasm shell scripting, OAuth port binding) in suites this diff never touches. `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`: no issues in changed files.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

Which function could be at 90? `_containsVoxelNode` in js_app_engine.dart — complexity: if/else-if, loops, recursion... CRAP = crap(comp, coverage) = comp² + comp×(1−coverage). If comp ~9 and coverage 0 → 90. comp 9 ≈ 8 decision points + 1. `_containsVoxelNode`: `depth > 64` (1), `is Map` (2), `== 'voxel'` (3), for loop (4), `is List` (5), for loop (6) → comp 7 → 7²=49+7×(1−cov). # crap4dart configuration for the flutter_app package.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart

# RATCHET (issue #433): the threshold is pinned at the CURRENT worst score
# measured by the SAME pipeline…

blocks.text:
# crap4dart configuration for the flutter_app package.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET (issue #433): the threshold is pinned at the CURRENT worst score
# measured by the SAME pipeline the CI gate uses — `flutter test --coverage`
# lcov (E2: widget-test coverage differs from the core's dart lcov, so the
# number must come from this pipeline, not the core's).
# Bootstrap (2026-09-15): 2450.0 — `JsAppEngine._faCall` (CC 49, 0% line
# coverage). Descent #1 (same day): the issue's three named offenders went
# under the next milestone line (CRAP ≤ 40 each) and the threshold followed
# the measured new worst: 2450.0 → 870.0 (`wasm_shell_git.run` and
# `main`, CC 29 at 0% coverage). Descent #2 (issue #475): both beasts
# decomposed into route-table dispatch + per-family handlers with a 51-test
# golden suite, and the cluster's own 812/702/600/506 beasts went down with
# them; the threshold follows the new measured worst: 870.0 → 650.0
# (`runCodemieSsoFlow`, CC 25 at 0% cov — another lane's ladder card).
# Descent #9 (issue #485): the on-device provider stream functions moved to
# one shared pump + codec walk (lib/on_device/), and the beasts went down
# with them — gemma 992 → 9, transformers.js 552/506 → 17/1, webllm 420 → 6
# (all fully covered by the provider suites + the new codec-table/pump
# tests); the threshold follows the measured new worst: 650.0 → 380.0
# (`WasiSandboxShell._runStage`, CC 19 at 0% cov — the wasm_shell cluster,
# another lane's ladder card).
# Pushes may only make the codebase BETTER,
# never worse; scripts/check_crap_guards.py --only-down rejects a raised
# threshold in CI. The staged ladder continues in follow-up cards:
# 870 → … → 40 (see AGENTS.md "Quality gates"). Re-measure after each fix:
# cd flutter_app && flutter test --coverage &&
# dart pub global run crap4dart analyze.

sources: [lib]

# Same generated set as the root config (E1 parity — asserted by
# scripts/check_crap_guards.py).
exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in flutter_app/lib under the flutter lcov
  # pipeline. Descent #10 (issue #558): the wasm_shell pipeline-engine
  # cluster went down (_runStage 380→4, _runPipeline 210→4, _evalExpr
  # 182→3, _rewriteRelativeArgs 110→2, _maybeRewritePath 72→3, all 100%
  # covered by test/wasm_shell_pipeline_test.dart); the threshold follows
  # the measured new worst: 380.0 → 272.0 (`WasiSandboxShell._xargsBuiltin`,
  # CC 16 at 0% cov — the wasm_shell builtins cluster, the next lane's
  # ladder card). Only down.
  # Descent #11 (issue #559): the wasm_shell builtins cluster went down
  # (xargs 272→7, _parsePrimary 210→3, _testBuiltin 132→9, du 132→3,
  # tac 90→6, tr 25.9→4, pip 72→3, _expandTrSet 30.8→gone — table/spec
  # driven parse helpers now live in wasm_shell_builtins.dart with direct
  # unit tests, the exec halves are covered e2e in
  # test/wasm_shell_pipeline_test.dart); the threshold follows the
  # measured new worst: 272.0 → 210.0 (`GemmaService.chatStream`, CC 14
  # at 0% cov — another lane's ladder card). Only down.
  # Descent #12 (issue #701): the 0%-coverage trio went down (_statBuiltin
  # 156→12.1 @ 91% cov via test/wasm_shell_stat_test.dart, isFaCliInstalled
  # 110→6 via the extracted faCliProbe seam + test/sessions_root_test.dart,
  # _showAppMenu 90→9 @ 100% cov via test/apps/apps_panel_menu_test.dart);
  # the threshold follows the measured new worst: 210.0 → 30.0 (the CC-5
  # 0%-cov tier: routeExtHostMessage, codemie _createController, attached
  # _AttachedRow.build, GemmaService.loadModel — the next ladder cards).
  # Re-measured on the CI pipeline (app-crap-gate run 35479048998): local
  # lcov is impossible on the agent cube (the flutter coverage collector
  # canonicalizes source paths and lstat EPERMs through .worktrees). Only
  # down.
  # TEMP raise (owner call 2026-09-26, mirrors dmtools-dart #256): the #955
  # network-mode merge shipped widgets without tests — max CRAP 72.0
  # (_ChannelRailState._createChannel, CC 8 @ 0% cov). Restore to 30.0 via
  # the linked issue.
  # raise-issue: gh-992
  # Restored (gh-992, 2026-09-27): the agents/enroll DAP-tab rework
  # (fcd2d0232) covered the #955 network UI — 5 enroll dialog groups +
  # channel_rail/chat_page call-site suites, 72 focused tests; re-measured
  # on the full local flutter lcov (3292 green): max CRAP 30.0, the
  # threshold follows back down 75.0 → 30.0. Only down.
  threshold: 30.0

coverage:
  # The CI app-crap-gate job merges the two flutter-tests shard reports
  # (scripts/merge_lcov.py) right before the CRAP step. Pre-commit stays
  # core-only: flutter coverage is too heavy for every commit.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  # flutter's lcov carries no BRDA branch records; branch coverage stays
  # a core-package gate concern.
  branch_coverage: false
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole flutter suite
  # first. Coverage comes from the CI shard merge (scripts/merge_lcov.py)
  # and pre-commit stays core-only (#433 split); nobody wants a second
  # suite run inside a 6-minute gate job.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# This config is the single source of which gates `crap4dart check` runs
# (CI app-crap-gate job, pre-commit core hook): 0.9.5 default-enables ALL
# built-in gates, so everything not enforced below is disabled explicitly.

- **Author**: ai-teammate

## PR Description

Closes #1441
### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS (`LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`), run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.
- Regression sweep on this runner: `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` → **543 passed, 0 failed** (the CI exzone surface, engines live); the diff's importing suites (`test/golden`, `app_launcher_screen_test`, `chat_screen_test`, `analytics_guard_test`) → 41 passed; full `flutter_app` suite failures (222) are byte-identical on the pre-fix baseline commit and confined to the host-locked golden suite (220 — documented ubuntu-excluded in `ci.yml`) plus 2 env-bound legs (wasm shell scripting, OAuth port binding) in suites this diff never touches. `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`: no issues in changed files.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

Some function in `flutter_app` (per `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml` scope) has CRAP score 90 (max threshold 30). CRAP = comp+¹ × coverage-weighted. A CRAP of 90 means a complex, UNCOVERED function. My change touched only a test file — tests don't enter the crap scope (lib scope). The previous pass added code to `js_app_engine.dart` (`_containsVoxelNode` recursion, `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld`) and `apps_golden_test.dart`... but lib files are the scope.

Which function has CRAP 90? The CI ratchet doesn't name it in this tail — let me run crap4dart locally to find it. The CRAP gate measures coverage-weighted crap: the CI merges app-coverage shards and computes. My local run can reproduce: `cd flutter_app && dart pub global run crap4dart analyze` needs the coverage lcov at flutter_app/coverage/lcov.info presumably.

Which function could be at 90? `_containsVoxelNode` in js_app_engine.dart — complexity: if/else-if, loops, recursion... CRAP = crap(comp, coverage) = comp² + comp×(1−coverage). If comp ~9 and coverage 0 → 90. comp 9 ≈ 8 decision points + 1. `_containsVoxelNode`: `depth > 64` (1), `is Map` (2), `== 'voxel'` (3), for loop (4), `is List` (5), for loop (6) → comp 7 → 7²=49+7×(1−cov). "CRAP threshold exceeded: 90.00 > 30.0" — the gate reports the WORST offender. The ratchet baseline should hold known offenders. # crap4dart configuration for the flutter_app package.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET (issue #433): the threshold is pinned at the CURRENT worst score
# measured by the SAME pipeline…

blocks.text:
# crap4dart configuration for the flutter_app package.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET (issue #433): the threshold is pinned at the CURRENT worst score
# measured by the SAME pipeline the CI gate uses — `flutter test --coverage`
# lcov (E2: widget-test coverage differs from the core's dart lcov, so the
# number must come from this pipeline, not the core's).
# Bootstrap (2026-09-15): 2450.0 — `JsAppEngine._faCall` (CC 49, 0% line
# coverage). Descent #1 (same day): the issue's three named offenders went
# under the next milestone line (CRAP ≤ 40 each) and the threshold followed
# the measured new worst: 2450.0 → 870.0 (`wasm_shell_git.run` and
# `main`, CC 29 at 0% coverage). Descent #2 (issue #475): both beasts
# decomposed into route-table dispatch + per-family handlers with a 51-test
# golden suite, and the cluster's own 812/702/600/506 beasts went down with
# them; the threshold follows the new measured worst: 870.0 → 650.0
# (`runCodemieSsoFlow`, CC 25 at 0% cov — another lane's ladder card).
# Descent #9 (issue #485): the on-device provider stream functions moved to
# one shared pump + codec walk (lib/on_device/), and the beasts went down
# with them — gemma 992 → 9, transformers.js 552/506 → 17/1, webllm 420 → 6
# (all fully covered by the provider suites + the new codec-table/pump
# tests); the threshold follows the measured new worst: 650.0 → 380.0
# (`WasiSandboxShell._runStage`, CC 19 at 0% cov — the wasm_shell cluster,
# another lane's ladder card).
# Pushes may only make the codebase BETTER,
# never worse; scripts/check_crap_guards.py --only-down rejects a raised
# threshold in CI. The staged ladder continues in follow-up cards:
# 870 → … → 40 (see AGENTS.md "Quality gates"). Re-measure after each fix:
# cd flutter_app && flutter test --coverage &&
# dart pub global run crap4dart analyze.

sources: [lib]

# Same generated set as the root config (E1 parity — asserted by
# scripts/check_crap_guards.py).
exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in flutter_app/lib under the flutter lcov
  # pipeline. Descent #10 (issue #558): the wasm_shell pipeline-engine
  # cluster went down (_runStage 380→4, _runPipeline 210→4, _evalExpr
  # 182→3, _rewriteRelativeArgs 110→2, _maybeRewritePath 72→3, all 100%
  # covered by test/wasm_shell_pipeline_test.dart); the threshold follows
  # the measured new worst: 380.0 → 272.0 (`WasiSandboxShell._xargsBuiltin`,
  # CC 16 at 0% cov — the wasm_shell builtins cluster, the next lane's
  # ladder card). Only down.
  # Descent #11 (issue #559): the wasm_shell builtins cluster went down
  # (xargs 272→7, _parsePrimary 210→3, _testBuiltin 132→9, du 132→3,
  # tac 90→6, tr 25.9→4, pip 72→3, _expandTrSet 30.8→gone — table/spec
  # driven parse helpers now live in wasm_shell_builtins.dart with direct
  # unit tests, the exec halves are covered e2e in
  # test/wasm_shell_pipeline_test.dart); the threshold follows the
  # measured new worst: 272.0 → 210.0 (`GemmaService.chatStream`, CC 14
  # at 0% cov — another lane's ladder card). Only down.
  # Descent #12 (issue #701): the 0%-coverage trio went down (_statBuiltin
  # 156→12.1 @ 91% cov via test/wasm_shell_stat_test.dart, isFaCliInstalled
  # 110→6 via the extracted faCliProbe seam + test/sessions_root_test.dart,
  # _showAppMenu 90→9 @ 100% cov via test/apps/apps_panel_menu_test.dart);
  # the threshold follows the measured new worst: 210.0 → 30.0 (the CC-5
  # 0%-cov tier: routeExtHostMessage, codemie _createController, attached
  # _AttachedRow.build, GemmaService.loadModel — the next ladder cards).
  # Re-measured on the CI pipeline (app-crap-gate run 35479048998): local
  # lcov is impossible on the agent cube (the flutter coverage collector
  # canonicalizes source paths and lstat EPERMs through .worktrees). Only
  # down.
  # TEMP raise (owner call 2026-09-26, mirrors dmtools-dart #256): the #955
  # network-mode merge shipped widgets without tests — max CRAP 72.0
  # (_ChannelRailState._createChannel, CC 8 @ 0% cov). Restore to 30.0 via
  # the linked issue.
  # raise-issue: gh-992
  # Restored (gh-992, 2026-09-27): the agents/enroll DAP-tab rework
  # (fcd2d0232) covered the #955 network UI — 5 enroll dialog groups +
  # channel_rail/chat_page call-site suites, 72 focused tests; re-measured
  # on the full local flutter lcov (3292 green): max CRAP 30.0, the
  # threshold follows back down 75.0 → 30.0. Only down.
  threshold: 30.0

coverage:
  # The CI app-crap-gate job merges the two flutter-tests shard reports
  # (scripts/merge_lcov.py) right before the CRAP step. Pre-commit stays
  # core-only: flutter coverage is too heavy for every commit.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  # flutter's lcov carries no BRDA branch records; branch coverage stays
  # a core-package gate concern.
  branch_coverage: false
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole flutter suite
  # first. Coverage comes from the CI shard merge (scripts/merge_lcov.py)
  # and pre-commit stays core-only (#433 split); nobody wants a second
  # suite run inside a 6-minute gate job.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# This config is the single source of which gates `crap4dart check` runs
# (CI app-crap-gate job, pre-commit core hook): 0.9.5 default-enables ALL
# built-in gates, so everything not enforced below is disabled explicitly.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh
  # stage_size + the ci.yml shell guard). agent_service.dart and
  # wasm_shell.dart sit under 2800 today; the app_localizations*.dart
  # pattern covers ALL gen-l10n output (base + every locale variant —
  # en/ru today, future locales automatically): generated files no human
  # edits, excluded here, not baselined.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - 'lib/l10n/app_localizations*.dart'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet below already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false}
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  duplication: {enabled: false} # own jscpd <1% guard (global %) — 0.10.0's
    # `duplication.sources` cross-module key stays available if the jscpd

{"content":"# gh-1441 rework — all open review threads addressed and verified green on the live bridge

## Issues/Notes

- The two open review threads (the automated `REQUEST_CHANGES` review and its gh-807 verdict record) were re-verified finding-by-finding against the current head. The BLOCKING finding (unwired third `JsonWidgetRenderer` site in `app_tile_host.dart` + a guard that scanned 2 of 3 sites), the IMPORTANT AC4-golden gap, and two of the three suggestions were already resolved on this branch; this rework pass **verified each fix** and found + fixed one genuine red the review rounds could not have seen (see below).
- **New fix in this pass:** `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` was RED at head — `a LIVE shipped-backend engine with a wired world never fires the diagnostic — re-armed across restarts` failed. The test asserted `AppLog.dump(), isEmpty`, but main's gh-1336 (`01553519a`, merged into this branch) added a legitimate `engine start: <app>/<entry>` INFO line on every boot, so the assertion could never hold on a live bridge (Linux QuickJS here, the CI macOS exzone leg). The test now asserts the **diagnostic** never fired (filters the dump for the unique `no voxelWorld is wired` phrase) — the AC3 contract itself is unchanged and still pinned. The two `isEmpty` assertions in never-started/disposed paths legitimately hold (no boot → no log lines) and stay as-is.
- Runner note (no repo change): `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` declares the gitignored `.env` asset; `flutter test` cannot build the asset bundle without it — created an empty `.env` locally to run the suites.
- Skipped as time-consuming (documented in PR + test headers, unchanged): ticket edge cases E3 (two-engine cross-talk), E5 (`jsr.capture` golden), and the REG-2 web-worker backend leg (upstream-owned, not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING — third renderer site:** `flutter_app/lib/apps/app_tile_host.dart:407` passes `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` and reports a null world on a voxel tree via `engine.noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)` (`app_tile_host.dart:412`), mirroring the other two surfaces. A tree-wide grep finds exactly three `JsonWidgetRenderer(` sites in `flutter_app/lib` — all three wired.
- **BLOCKING — guard completeness:** `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` scans **every** `.dart` file under `flutter_app/lib` (`rendererRoot`) and asserts every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` passes `voxelWorld:` — the reviewer's directory-wide option, so a fourth site can never silently escape. The known three files survive as a `knownSurfaces` floor: if one stops being visible to the scan (moved/renamed file, broken scanner), the run goes RED with a "fix the guard before trusting a green run" reason instead of turning vacuously green. Failures report `path:line` computed from a length-preserving masked source.
- **IMPORTANT — AC4 golden:** fixture-based golden exactly as the review suggested — `flutter_app/test/golden/apps_golden_test.dart` builds the renderer with a **hand-fed `JsVoxelWorld`** (the exact `voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh`/`voxel.camera` hostCall payloads a real engine's bridge world receives), no engine and no native JS bridge, deterministic on any host. Snapshot `test/golden/goldens/apps_voxel_world.png` committed; the test additionally pixel-probes the captured subtree for both camera sky and painted chunk geometry (an all-sky frame — the gh-1441 bug class — fails the run). `golden_guard_test.dart` resolves it via the existing `lib/apps/js_app_view.dart → apps_golden_test.dart` coverage entry + on-disk snapshot check; `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` confirms no orphan PNG.
- **SUGGESTION — one-shot diagnostic:** adopted as sketched — `js_app_engine.dart:440` re-arms `_unwiredVoxelNoted` in `_start()`; `js_app_engine.dart:400` requires a live engine with a null world. The boot/restart gap can no longer fire (or spend) the diagnostic; every fresh boot re-arms it. - **Author**: ai-teammate

- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T18:53:50Z

## PR Description

Closes #1441
### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS (`LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`), run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.
- Regression sweep on this runner: `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` → **543 passed, 0 failed** (the CI exzone surface, engines live); the diff's importing suites (`test/golden`, `app_launcher_screen_test`, `chat_screen_test`, `analytics_guard_test`) → 41 passed; full `flutter_app` suite failures (222) are byte-identical on the pre-fix baseline commit and confined to the host-locked golden suite (220 — documented ubuntu-excluded in `ci.yml`) plus 2 env-bound legs (wasm shell scripting, OAuth port binding) in suites this diff never touches. `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`: no issues in changed files.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

Which function could be at 90? `_containsVoxelNode` in js_app_engine.dart — complexity: if/else-if, loops, recursion... CRAP = crap(comp, coverage) = comp² + comp×(1−coverage). If comp ~9 and coverage 0 → 90. comp 9 ≈ 8 decision points + 1. `_containsVoxelNode`: `depth > 64` (1), `is Map` (2), `== 'voxel'` (3), for loop (4), `is List` (5), for loop (6) → comp 7 → 7²=49+7×(1−cov). # crap4dart configuration for the flutter_app package.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET (issue #433): the threshold is pinned at the CURRENT worst score
# measured by the SAME pipeline…

blocks.text:
# crap4dart configuration for the flutter_app package.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET (issue #433): the threshold is pinned at the CURRENT worst score
# measured by the SAME pipeline the CI gate uses — `flutter test --coverage`
# lcov (E2: widget-test coverage differs from the core's dart lcov, so the
# number must come from this pipeline, not the core's).
# Bootstrap (2026-09-15): 2450.0 — `JsAppEngine._faCall` (CC 49, 0% line
# coverage). Descent #1 (same day): the issue's three named offenders went
# under the next milestone line (CRAP ≤ 40 each) and the threshold followed
# the measured new worst: 2450.0 → 870.0 (`wasm_shell_git.run` and
# `main`, CC 29 at 0% coverage). Descent #2 (issue #475): both beasts
# decomposed into route-table dispatch + per-family handlers with a 51-test
# golden suite, and the cluster's own 812/702/600/506 beasts went down with
# them; the threshold follows the new measured worst: 870.0 → 650.0
# (`runCodemieSsoFlow`, CC 25 at 0% cov — another lane's ladder card).
# Descent #9 (issue #485): the on-device provider stream functions moved to
# one shared pump + codec walk (lib/on_device/), and the beasts went down
# with them — gemma 992 → 9, transformers.js 552/506 → 17/1, webllm 420 → 6
# (all fully covered by the provider suites + the new codec-table/pump
# tests); the threshold follows the measured new worst: 650.0 → 380.0
# (`WasiSandboxShell._runStage`, CC 19 at 0% cov — the wasm_shell cluster,
# another lane's ladder card).
# Pushes may only make the codebase BETTER,
# never worse; scripts/check_crap_guards.py --only-down rejects a raised
# threshold in CI. The staged ladder continues in follow-up cards:
# 870 → … → 40 (see AGENTS.md "Quality gates"). Re-measure after each fix:
# cd flutter_app && flutter test --coverage &&
# dart pub global run crap4dart analyze.

sources: [lib]

# Same generated set as the root config (E1 parity — asserted by
# scripts/check_crap_guards.py).
exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in flutter_app/lib under the flutter lcov
  # pipeline. Descent #10 (issue #558): the wasm_shell pipeline-engine
  # cluster went down (_runStage 380→4, _runPipeline 210→4, _evalExpr
  # 182→3, _rewriteRelativeArgs 110→2, _maybeRewritePath 72→3, all 100%
  # covered by test/wasm_shell_pipeline_test.dart); the threshold follows
  # the measured new worst: 380.0 → 272.0 (`WasiSandboxShell._xargsBuiltin`,
  # CC 16 at 0% cov — the wasm_shell builtins cluster, the next lane's
  # ladder card). Only down.
  # Descent #11 (issue #559): the wasm_shell builtins cluster went down
  # (xargs 272→7, _parsePrimary 210→3, _testBuiltin 132→9, du 132→3,
  # tac 90→6, tr 25.9→4, pip 72→3, _expandTrSet 30.8→gone — table/spec
  # driven parse helpers now live in wasm_shell_builtins.dart with direct
  # unit tests, the exec halves are covered e2e in
  # test/wasm_shell_pipeline_test.dart); the threshold follows the
  # measured new worst: 272.0 → 210.0 (`GemmaService.chatStream`, CC 14
  # at 0% cov — another lane's ladder card). Only down.
  # Descent #12 (issue #701): the 0%-coverage trio went down (_statBuiltin
  # 156→12.1 @ 91% cov via test/wasm_shell_stat_test.dart, isFaCliInstalled
  # 110→6 via the extracted faCliProbe seam + test/sessions_root_test.dart,
  # _showAppMenu 90→9 @ 100% cov via test/apps/apps_panel_menu_test.dart);
  # the threshold follows the measured new worst: 210.0 → 30.0 (the CC-5
  # 0%-cov tier: routeExtHostMessage, codemie _createController, attached
  # _AttachedRow.build, GemmaService.loadModel — the next ladder cards).
  # Re-measured on the CI pipeline (app-crap-gate run 35479048998): local
  # lcov is impossible on the agent cube (the flutter coverage collector
  # canonicalizes source paths and lstat EPERMs through .worktrees). Only
  # down.
  # TEMP raise (owner call 2026-09-26, mirrors dmtools-dart #256): the #955
  # network-mode merge shipped widgets without tests — max CRAP 72.0
  # (_ChannelRailState._createChannel, CC 8 @ 0% cov). Restore to 30.0 via
  # the linked issue.
  # raise-issue: gh-992
  # Restored (gh-992, 2026-09-27): the agents/enroll DAP-tab rework
  # (fcd2d0232) covered the #955 network UI — 5 enroll dialog groups +
  # channel_rail/chat_page call-site suites, 72 focused tests; re-measured
  # on the full local flutter lcov (3292 green): max CRAP 30.0, the
  # threshold follows back down 75.0 → 30.0. Only down.
  threshold: 30.0

coverage:
  # The CI app-crap-gate job merges the two flutter-tests shard reports
  # (scripts/merge_lcov.py) right before the CRAP step. Pre-commit stays
  # core-only: flutter coverage is too heavy for every commit.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  # flutter's lcov carries no BRDA branch records; branch coverage stays
  # a core-package gate concern.
  branch_coverage: false
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole flutter suite
  # first. Coverage comes from the CI shard merge (scripts/merge_lcov.py)
  # and pre-commit stays core-only (#433 split); nobody wants a second
  # suite run inside a 6-minute gate job.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# This config is the single source of which gates `crap4dart check` runs
# (CI app-crap-gate job, pre-commit core hook): 0.9.5 default-enables ALL
# built-in gates, so everything not enforced below is disabled explicitly.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh
  # stage_size + the ci.yml shell guard). agent_service.dart and
  # wasm_shell.dart sit under 2800 today; the app_localizations*.dart
  # pattern covers ALL gen-l10n output (base + every locale variant —
  # en/ru today, future locales automatically): generated files no human
  # edits, excluded here, not baselined.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - 'lib/l10n/app_localizations*.dart'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet below already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false}
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  duplication: {enabled: false} # own jscpd <1% guard (global %) — 0.10.0's
    # `duplication.sources` cross-module key stays available if the jscpd
    # guards are ever retired (mirrors the root crap4dart.yaml)
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}

{"content":"# gh-1441 rework — all open review threads addressed and verified green on the live bridge

## Issues/Notes

- The two open review threads (the automated `REQUEST_CHANGES` review and its gh-807 verdict record) were re-verified finding-by-finding against the current head. The BLOCKING finding (unwired third `JsonWidgetRenderer` site in `app_tile_host.dart` + a guard that scanned 2 of 3 sites), the IMPORTANT AC4-golden gap, and two of the three suggestions were already resolved on this branch; this rework pass **verified each fix** and found + fixed one genuine red the review rounds could not have seen (see below).
- **New fix in this pass:** `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` was RED at head — `a LIVE shipped-backend engine with a wired world never fires the diagnostic — re-armed across restarts` failed. The test asserted `AppLog.dump(), isEmpty`, but main's gh-1336 (`01553519a`, merged into this branch) added a legitimate `engine start: <app>/<entry>` INFO line on every boot, so the assertion could never hold on a live bridge (Linux QuickJS here, the CI macOS exzone leg). The test now asserts the **diagnostic** never fired (filters the dump for the unique `no voxelWorld is wired` phrase) — the AC3 contract itself is unchanged and still pinned. The two `isEmpty` assertions in never-started/disposed paths legitimately hold (no boot → no log lines) and stay as-is.
- Runner note (no repo change): `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` declares the gitignored `.env` asset; `flutter test` cannot build the asset bundle without it — created an empty `.env` locally to run the suites.
- Skipped as time-consuming (documented in PR + test headers, unchanged): ticket edge cases E3 (two-engine cross-talk), E5 (`jsr.capture` golden), and the REG-2 web-worker backend leg (upstream-owned, not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING — third renderer site:** `flutter_app/lib/apps/app_tile_host.dart:407` passes `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` and reports a null world on a voxel tree via `engine.noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)` (`app_tile_host.dart:412`), mirroring the other two surfaces. A tree-wide grep finds exactly three `JsonWidgetRenderer(` sites in `flutter_app/lib` — all three wired.
- **BLOCKING — guard completeness:** `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` scans **every** `.dart` file under `flutter_app/lib` (`rendererRoot`) and asserts every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` passes `voxelWorld:` — the reviewer's directory-wide option, so a fourth site can never silently escape. The known three files survive as a `knownSurfaces` floor: if one stops being visible to the scan (moved/renamed file, broken scanner), the run goes RED with a "fix the guard before trusting a green run" reason instead of turning vacuously green. Failures report `path:line` computed from a length-preserving masked source.
- **IMPORTANT — AC4 golden:** fixture-based golden exactly as the review suggested — `flutter_app/test/golden/apps_golden_test.dart` builds the renderer with a **hand-fed `JsVoxelWorld`** (the exact `voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh`/`voxel.camera` hostCall payloads a real engine's bridge world receives), no engine and no native JS bridge, deterministic on any host. Snapshot `test/golden/goldens/apps_voxel_world.png` committed; the test additionally pixel-probes the captured subtree for both camera sky and painted chunk geometry (an all-sky frame — the gh-1441 bug class — fails the run). `golden_guard_test.dart` resolves it via the existing `lib/apps/js_app_view.dart → apps_golden_test.dart` coverage entry + on-disk snapshot check; `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` confirms no orphan PNG.
- **SUGGESTION — one-shot diagnostic:** adopted as sketched — `js_app_engine.dart:440` re-arms `_unwiredVoxelNoted` in `_start()`; `js_app_engine.dart:400` requires a live engine with a null world. The boot/restart gap can no longer fire (or spend) the diagnostic; every fresh boot re-arms it. Pinned behaviorally (boot-gap silent, disposed silent, live-backend silent across restarts) and statically (the root guard asserts both code shapes).
- **SUGGESTION — scanner hardening:** `maskedForScan` tracks `'` and `"` (plus `'''`/`"""`), raw strings, `\` escapes, and `//` + `/* … */` comments, masking interiors while preserving length/newlines; `balancedArgs` runs on masked text. Accepted-input contract documented (failure direction: false RED, never false GREEN); 7 scanner unit pins added.

## Files Modified

- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — this pass (+10/−1, commit `ad392ded9`): the AC3 live-backend test asserts the diagnostic never fired instead of an empty `AppLog` buffer (merge-window fix, RED→GREEN proven on the live QuickJS bridge).
- Already on the branch and verified by this pass (the PR's 11-file diff): `flutter_app/lib/apps/{js_app_engine,js_app_view,dynamic_widget_tile,app_tile_host}.dart`, `flutter_app/test/apps/{js_app_engine_voxel_world,js_app_view_voxel,dynamic_widget_tile_voxel}_test.dart`, `flutter_app/test/golden/apps_golden_test.dart`, `flutter_app/test/golden/goldens/apps_voxel_world.png`, `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart`.

- `flutter test test/golden/golden_guard_test.dart`: **3/3 passed**; voxel golden (`apps_voxel_world`) **passed** pixel-exact on this runner; `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick`: snapshots present, no orphans.
- `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings` (flutter_app): exit 0, **0 errors**; no analyzer issues in any file this PR touches (107 infos, all pre-existing in unrelated files).

- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1441` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11

- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T11:45:40Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T18:53:50Z

## PR Description

Closes #1441
### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS (`LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`), run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.
- Regression sweep on this runner: `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` → **543 passed, 0 failed** (the CI exzone surface, engines live); the diff's importing suites (`test/golden`, `app_launcher_screen_test`, `chat_screen_test`, `analytics_guard_test`) → 41 passed; full `flutter_app` suite failures (222) are byte-identical on the pre-fix baseline commit and confined to the host-locked golden suite (220 — documented ubuntu-excluded in `ci.yml`) plus 2 env-bound legs (wasm shell scripting, OAuth port binding) in suites this diff never touches. `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`: no issues in changed files.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

Which function could be at 90? `_containsVoxelNode` in js_app_engine.dart — complexity: if/else-if, loops, recursion... CRAP = crap(comp, coverage) = comp² + comp×(1−coverage). If comp ~9 and coverage 0 → 90. comp 9 ≈ 8 decision points + 1. `_containsVoxelNode`: `depth > 64` (1), `is Map` (2), `== 'voxel'` (3), for loop (4), `is List` (5), for loop (6) → comp 7 → 7²=49+7×(1−cov). blocks.text:
# crap4dart configuration for the flutter_app package.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET (issue #433): the threshold is pinned at the CURRENT worst score
# measured by the SAME pipeline the CI gate uses — `flutter test --coverage`
# lcov (E2: widget-test coverage differs from the core's dart lcov, so the
# number must come from this pipeline, not the core's).
# Bootstrap (2026-09-15): 2450.0 — `JsAppEngine._faCall` (CC 49, 0% line
# coverage). Descent #1 (same day): the issue's three named offenders went
# under the next milestone line (CRAP ≤ 40 each) and the threshold followed
# the measured new worst: 2450.0 → 870.0 (`wasm_shell_git.run` and
# `main`, CC 29 at 0% coverage). Descent #2 (issue #475): both beasts
# decomposed into route-table dispatch + per-family handlers with a 51-test
# golden suite, and the cluster's own 812/702/600/506 beasts went down with
# them; the threshold follows the new measured worst: 870.0 → 650.0
# (`runCodemieSsoFlow`, CC 25 at 0% cov — another lane's ladder card).
# Descent #9 (issue #485): the on-device provider stream functions moved to
# one shared pump + codec walk (lib/on_device/), and the beasts went down
# with them — gemma 992 → 9, transformers.js 552/506 → 17/1, webllm 420 → 6
# (all fully covered by the provider suites + the new codec-table/pump
# tests); the threshold follows the measured new worst: 650.0 → 380.0
# (`WasiSandboxShell._runStage`, CC 19 at 0% cov — the wasm_shell cluster,
# another lane's ladder card).
# Pushes may only make the codebase BETTER,
# never worse; scripts/check_crap_guards.py --only-down rejects a raised
# threshold in CI. The staged ladder continues in follow-up cards:
# 870 → … → 40 (see AGENTS.md "Quality gates"). Re-measure after each fix:
# cd flutter_app && flutter test --coverage &&
# dart pub global run crap4dart analyze.

sources: [lib]

# Same generated set as the root config (E1 parity — asserted by
# scripts/check_crap_guards.py).
exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in flutter_app/lib under the flutter lcov
  # pipeline. Descent #10 (issue #558): the wasm_shell pipeline-engine
  # cluster went down (_runStage 380→4, _runPipeline 210→4, _evalExpr
  # 182→3, _rewriteRelativeArgs 110→2, _maybeRewritePath 72→3, all 100%
  # covered by test/wasm_shell_pipeline_test.dart); the threshold follows
  # the measured new worst: 380.0 → 272.0 (`WasiSandboxShell._xargsBuiltin`,
  # CC 16 at 0% cov — the wasm_shell builtins cluster, the next lane's
  # ladder card). Only down.
  # Descent #11 (issue #559): the wasm_shell builtins cluster went down
  # (xargs 272→7, _parsePrimary 210→3, _testBuiltin 132→9, du 132→3,
  # tac 90→6, tr 25.9→4, pip 72→3, _expandTrSet 30.8→gone — table/spec
  # driven parse helpers now live in wasm_shell_builtins.dart with direct
  # unit tests, the exec halves are covered e2e in
  # test/wasm_shell_pipeline_test.dart); the threshold follows the
  # measured new worst: 272.0 → 210.0 (`GemmaService.chatStream`, CC 14
  # at 0% cov — another lane's ladder card). Only down.
  # Descent #12 (issue #701): the 0%-coverage trio went down (_statBuiltin
  # 156→12.1 @ 91% cov via test/wasm_shell_stat_test.dart, isFaCliInstalled
  # 110→6 via the extracted faCliProbe seam + test/sessions_root_test.dart,
  # _showAppMenu 90→9 @ 100% cov via test/apps/apps_panel_menu_test.dart);
  # the threshold follows the measured new worst: 210.0 → 30.0 (the CC-5
  # 0%-cov tier: routeExtHostMessage, codemie _createController, attached
  # _AttachedRow.build, GemmaService.loadModel — the next ladder cards).
  # Re-measured on the CI pipeline (app-crap-gate run 35479048998): local
  # lcov is impossible on the agent cube (the flutter coverage collector
  # canonicalizes source paths and lstat EPERMs through .worktrees). Only
  # down.
  # TEMP raise (owner call 2026-09-26, mirrors dmtools-dart #256): the #955
  # network-mode merge shipped widgets without tests — max CRAP 72.0
  # (_ChannelRailState._createChannel, CC 8 @ 0% cov). Restore to 30.0 via
  # the linked issue.
  # raise-issue: gh-992
  # Restored (gh-992, 2026-09-27): the agents/enroll DAP-tab rework
  # (fcd2d0232) covered the #955 network UI — 5 enroll dialog groups +
  # channel_rail/chat_page call-site suites, 72 focused tests; re-measured
  # on the full local flutter lcov (3292 green): max CRAP 30.0, the
  # threshold follows back down 75.0 → 30.0. Only down.
  threshold: 30.0

coverage:
  # The CI app-crap-gate job merges the two flutter-tests shard reports
  # (scripts/merge_lcov.py) right before the CRAP step. Pre-commit stays
  # core-only: flutter coverage is too heavy for every commit.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  # flutter's lcov carries no BRDA branch records; branch coverage stays
  # a core-package gate concern.
  branch_coverage: false
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole flutter suite
  # first. Coverage comes from the CI shard merge (scripts/merge_lcov.py)
  # and pre-commit stays core-only (#433 split); nobody wants a second
  # suite run inside a 6-minute gate job.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# This config is the single source of which gates `crap4dart check` runs
# (CI app-crap-gate job, pre-commit core hook): 0.9.5 default-enables ALL
# built-in gates, so everything not enforced below is disabled explicitly.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh
  # stage_size + the ci.yml shell guard). agent_service.dart and
  # wasm_shell.dart sit under 2800 today; the app_localizations*.dart
  # pattern covers ALL gen-l10n output (base + every locale variant —
  # en/ru today, future locales automatically): generated files no human
  # edits, excluded here, not baselined.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - 'lib/l10n/app_localizations*.dart'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet below already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false}
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  duplication: {enabled: false} # own jscpd <1% guard (global %) — 0.10.0's
    # `duplication.sources` cross-module key stays available if the jscpd
    # guards are ever retired (mirrors the root crap4dart.yaml)
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over the golden set (165 PNGs). severity: warning + the
  # excludes below are the documented INTERIM mitigation (#447): the
  # 0.9.5 detector knows only 3 shapes — it missed both classes that
  # broke the 40 pre-font goldens of de2f11b9 (solid Ahem text
  # rectangles, hollow icon squares without an X) and false-positives on:
  #   - the Habit Tracker checkmark tile (green square + white V
  #     converging like an X signature; light theme only, the same 22px
  #     tile at x=234 in all 5 hits),
  #   - the yellow "25:00" digits on the dark timer card (row y=195 of
  #     apps_panel/panel_dark: yellow glyph edges alternate with the
  #     dark card ≥8px with ≥4 transitions — passes the stripe
  #     heuristic).
  # Each exclude is an upstream IstiN/crap4dart bug. Flip to
  # `severity: error` and drop the excludes when the upstream detector
  # fixes land — scripts/check_golden_detector.py re-verifies all six
  # classes against this exact detector (see its docstring).
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    dirs: [test/golden/goldens]
    exclude:
      # false positives: green checkmark tile reads as an X (light theme)
      - 'test/golden/goldens/launcher/grid_light.png'
      - 'test/golden/goldens/launcher/sheet_bar_light.png'
      - 'test/golden/goldens/launcher/sheet_bar_streaming_light.png…

{"content":"# gh-1441 rework — all open review threads addressed and verified green on the live bridge

## Issues/Notes

- The two open review threads (the automated `REQUEST_CHANGES` review and its gh-807 verdict record) were re-verified finding-by-finding against the current head. The BLOCKING finding (unwired third `JsonWidgetRenderer` site in `app_tile_host.dart` + a guard that scanned 2 of 3 sites), the IMPORTANT AC4-golden gap, and two of the three suggestions were already resolved on this branch; this rework pass **verified each fix** and found + fixed one genuine red the review rounds could not have seen (see below).
- **New fix in this pass:** `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` was RED at head — `a LIVE shipped-backend engine with a wired world never fires the diagnostic — re-armed across restarts` failed. The test asserted `AppLog.dump(), isEmpty`, but main's gh-1336 (`01553519a`, merged into this branch) added a legitimate `engine start: <app>/<entry>` INFO line on every boot, so the assertion could never hold on a live bridge (Linux QuickJS here, the CI macOS exzone leg). The test now asserts the **diagnostic** never fired (filters the dump for the unique `no voxelWorld is wired` phrase) — the AC3 contract itself is unchanged and still pinned. The two `isEmpty` assertions in never-started/disposed paths legitimately hold (no boot → no log lines) and stay as-is.
- Runner note (no repo change): `flutter_app/pubspec.yaml` declares the gitignored `.env` asset; `flutter test` cannot build the asset bundle without it — created an empty `.env` locally to run the suites.
- Skipped as time-consuming (documented in PR + test headers, unchanged): ticket edge cases E3 (two-engine cross-talk), E5 (`jsr.capture` golden), and the REG-2 web-worker backend leg (upstream-owned, not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING — third renderer site:** `flutter_app/lib/apps/app_tile_host.dart:407` passes `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` and reports a null world on a voxel tree via `engine.noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)` (`app_tile_host.dart:412`), mirroring the other two surfaces. A tree-wide grep finds exactly three `JsonWidgetRenderer(` sites in `flutter_app/lib` — all three wired.
- **BLOCKING — guard completeness:** `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` scans **every** `.dart` file under `flutter_app/lib` (`rendererRoot`) and asserts every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` passes `voxelWorld:` — the reviewer's directory-wide option, so a fourth site can never silently escape. The known three files survive as a `knownSurfaces` floor: if one stops being visible to the scan (moved/renamed file, broken scanner), the run goes RED with a "fix the guard before trusting a green run" reason instead of turning vacuously green. Failures report `path:line` computed from a length-preserving masked source.
- **IMPORTANT — AC4 golden:** fixture-based golden exactly as the review suggested — `flutter_app/test/golden/apps_golden_test.dart` builds the renderer with a **hand-fed `JsVoxelWorld`** (the exact `voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh`/`voxel.camera` hostCall payloads a real engine's bridge world receives), no engine and no native JS bridge, deterministic on any host. Snapshot `test/golden/goldens/apps_voxel_world.png` committed; the test additionally pixel-probes the captured subtree for both camera sky and painted chunk geometry (an all-sky frame — the gh-1441 bug class — fails the run). `golden_guard_test.dart` resolves it via the existing `lib/apps/js_app_view.dart → apps_golden_test.dart` coverage entry + on-disk snapshot check; `scripts/check_goldens.py --quick` confirms no orphan PNG.
- **SUGGESTION — one-shot diagnostic:** adopted as sketched — `js_app_engine.dart:440` re-arms `_unwiredVoxelNoted` in `_start()`; `js_app_engine.dart:400` requires a live engine with a null world. The boot/restart gap can no longer fire (or spend) the diagnostic; every fresh boot re-arms it. Pinned behaviorally (boot-gap silent, disposed silent, live-backend silent across restarts) and statically (the root guard asserts both code shapes).
- **SUGGESTION — scanner hardening:** `maskedForScan` tracks `'` and `"` (plus `'''`/`"""`), raw strings, `\` escapes, and `//` + `/* … */` comments, masking interiors while preserving length/newlines; `balancedArgs` runs on masked text. Accepted-input contract documented (failure direction: false RED, never false GREEN); 7 scanner unit pins added.

## Files Modified

- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — this pass (+10/−1, commit `ad392ded9`): the AC3 live-backend test asserts the diagnostic never fired instead of an empty `AppLog` buffer (merge-window fix, RED→GREEN proven on the live QuickJS bridge).

- **Title**: gh-1441 Voxel nodes render as the “Voxel world” placeholder — Fa app builds JsonWidgetRenderer without voxelWorld (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1441` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 11
- **Additions**: +1276
- **Deletions**: -3
- **Created**: 2026-10-09T11:45:40Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-09T18:53:50Z

## PR Description

Closes #1441
### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS (`LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH`), run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.
- Regression sweep on this runner: `flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps` → **543 passed, 0 failed** (the CI exzone surface, engines live); the diff's importing suites (`test/golden`, `app_launcher_screen_test`, `chat_screen_test`, `analytics_guard_test`) → 41 passed; full `flutter_app` suite failures (222) are byte-identical on the pre-fix baseline commit and confined to the host-locked golden suite (220 — documented ubuntu-excluded in `ci.yml`) plus 2 env-bound legs (wasm shell scripting, OAuth port binding) in suites this diff never touches. `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings`: no issues in changed files.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

# crap4dart configuration for the flutter_app package.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart

blocks.text:
# crap4dart configuration for the flutter_app package.
# https://github.com/IstiN/crap4dart
#
# RATCHET (issue #433): the threshold is pinned at the CURRENT worst score
# measured by the SAME pipeline the CI gate uses — `flutter test --coverage`
# lcov (E2: widget-test coverage differs from the core's dart lcov, so the
# number must come from this pipeline, not the core's).
# Bootstrap (2026-09-15): 2450.0 — `JsAppEngine._faCall` (CC 49, 0% line
# coverage). Descent #1 (same day): the issue's three named offenders went
# under the next milestone line (CRAP ≤ 40 each) and the threshold followed
# the measured new worst: 2450.0 → 870.0 (`wasm_shell_git.run` and
# `main`, CC 29 at 0% coverage). Descent #2 (issue #475): both beasts
# decomposed into route-table dispatch + per-family handlers with a 51-test
# golden suite, and the cluster's own 812/702/600/506 beasts went down with
# them; the threshold follows the new measured worst: 870.0 → 650.0
# (`runCodemieSsoFlow`, CC 25 at 0% cov — another lane's ladder card).
# Descent #9 (issue #485): the on-device provider stream functions moved to
# one shared pump + codec walk (lib/on_device/), and the beasts went down
# with them — gemma 992 → 9, transformers.js 552/506 → 17/1, webllm 420 → 6
# (all fully covered by the provider suites + the new codec-table/pump
# tests); the threshold follows the measured new worst: 650.0 → 380.0
# (`WasiSandboxShell._runStage`, CC 19 at 0% cov — the wasm_shell cluster,
# another lane's ladder card).
# Pushes may only make the codebase BETTER,
# never worse; scripts/check_crap_guards.py --only-down rejects a raised
# threshold in CI. The staged ladder continues in follow-up cards:
# 870 → … → 40 (see AGENTS.md "Quality gates"). Re-measure after each fix:
# cd flutter_app && flutter test --coverage &&
# dart pub global run crap4dart analyze.

sources: [lib]

# Same generated set as the root config (E1 parity — asserted by
# scripts/check_crap_guards.py).
exclude:
  - '**.g.dart'
  - '**.freezed.dart'
  - '**.mocks.dart'
  - 'build/**'

crap:
  enabled: true
  # Current max CRAP score in flutter_app/lib under the flutter lcov
  # pipeline. Descent #10 (issue #558): the wasm_shell pipeline-engine
  # cluster went down (_runStage 380→4, _runPipeline 210→4, _evalExpr
  # 182→3, _rewriteRelativeArgs 110→2, _maybeRewritePath 72→3, all 100%
  # covered by test/wasm_shell_pipeline_test.dart); the threshold follows
  # the measured new worst: 380.0 → 272.0 (`WasiSandboxShell._xargsBuiltin`,
  # CC 16 at 0% cov — the wasm_shell builtins cluster, the next lane's
  # ladder card). Only down.
  # Descent #11 (issue #559): the wasm_shell builtins cluster went down
  # (xargs 272→7, _parsePrimary 210→3, _testBuiltin 132→9, du 132→3,
  # tac 90→6, tr 25.9→4, pip 72→3, _expandTrSet 30.8→gone — table/spec
  # driven parse helpers now live in wasm_shell_builtins.dart with direct
  # unit tests, the exec halves are covered e2e in
  # test/wasm_shell_pipeline_test.dart); the threshold follows the
  # measured new worst: 272.0 → 210.0 (`GemmaService.chatStream`, CC 14
  # at 0% cov — another lane's ladder card). Only down.
  # Descent #12 (issue #701): the 0%-coverage trio went down (_statBuiltin
  # 156→12.1 @ 91% cov via test/wasm_shell_stat_test.dart, isFaCliInstalled
  # 110→6 via the extracted faCliProbe seam + test/sessions_root_test.dart,
  # _showAppMenu 90→9 @ 100% cov via test/apps/apps_panel_menu_test.dart);
  # the threshold follows the measured new worst: 210.0 → 30.0 (the CC-5
  # 0%-cov tier: routeExtHostMessage, codemie _createController, attached
  # _AttachedRow.build, GemmaService.loadModel — the next ladder cards).
  # Re-measured on the CI pipeline (app-crap-gate run 35479048998): local
  # lcov is impossible on the agent cube (the flutter coverage collector
  # canonicalizes source paths and lstat EPERMs through .worktrees). Only
  # down.
  # TEMP raise (owner call 2026-09-26, mirrors dmtools-dart #256): the #955
  # network-mode merge shipped widgets without tests — max CRAP 72.0
  # (_ChannelRailState._createChannel, CC 8 @ 0% cov). Restore to 30.0 via
  # the linked issue.
  # raise-issue: gh-992
  # Restored (gh-992, 2026-09-27): the agents/enroll DAP-tab rework
  # (fcd2d0232) covered the #955 network UI — 5 enroll dialog groups +
  # channel_rail/chat_page call-site suites, 72 focused tests; re-measured
  # on the full local flutter lcov (3292 green): max CRAP 30.0, the
  # threshold follows back down 75.0 → 30.0. Only down.
  threshold: 30.0

coverage:
  # The CI app-crap-gate job merges the two flutter-tests shard reports
  # (scripts/merge_lcov.py) right before the CRAP step. Pre-commit stays
  # core-only: flutter coverage is too heavy for every commit.
  lcov_path: coverage/lcov.info
  required: true
  # flutter's lcov carries no BRDA branch records; branch coverage stays
  # a core-package gate concern.
  branch_coverage: false
  # crap4dart 0.9.5 flipped the run_tests default to true — a bare
  # `analyze`/`check` would silently re-run the whole flutter suite
  # first. Coverage comes from the CI shard merge (scripts/merge_lcov.py)
  # and pre-commit stays core-only (#433 split); nobody wants a second
  # suite run inside a 6-minute gate job.
  run_tests: false

# ─── Gates (issue #447) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# This config is the single source of which gates `crap4dart check` runs
# (CI app-crap-gate job, pre-commit core hook): 0.9.5 default-enables ALL
# built-in gates, so everything not enforced below is disabled explicitly.
gates:
  # Issue #1234: whole-tree ≤2800-line guard (was scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh
  # stage_size + the ci.yml shell guard). agent_service.dart and
  # wasm_shell.dart sit under 2800 today; the app_localizations*.dart
  # pattern covers ALL gen-l10n output (base + every locale variant —
  # en/ru today, future locales automatically): generated files no human
  # edits, excluded here, not baselined.
  loc:
    enabled: true
    max_lines: 2800
    exclude:
      - 'lib/l10n/app_localizations*.dart'
  test_coverage: {enabled: false} # own ≥80% coverage-gate job
  complexity: {enabled: false} # CRAP ratchet below already covers it
  method_size: {enabled: false}
  nesting: {enabled: false}
  class_size: {enabled: false}
  weight_of_class: {enabled: false}
  unused_code: {enabled: false}
  unused_files: {enabled: false}
  banned_imports: {enabled: false}
  duplication: {enabled: false} # own jscpd <1% guard (global %) — 0.10.0's
    # `duplication.sources` cross-module key stays available if the jscpd
    # guards are ever retired (mirrors the root crap4dart.yaml)
  file_naming: {enabled: false}
  magic_constants: {enabled: false}
  test_assertions: {enabled: false}
  folder_structure: {enabled: false}
  external: {enabled: false}
  public_docs: {enabled: false}

  # Pixel gate over the golden set (165 PNGs). severity: warning + the
  # excludes below are the documented INTERIM mitigation (#447): the
  # 0.9.5 detector knows only 3 shapes — it missed both classes that
  # broke the 40 pre-font goldens of de2f11b9 (solid Ahem text
  # rectangles, hollow icon squares without an X) and false-positives on:
  #   - the Habit Tracker checkmark tile (green square + white V
  #     converging like an X signature; light theme only, the same 22px
  #     tile at x=234 in all 5 hits),
  #   - the yellow "25:00" digits on the dark timer card (row y=195 of
  #     apps_panel/panel_dark: yellow glyph edges alternate with the
  #     dark card ≥8px with ≥4 transitions — passes the stripe
  #     heuristic).
  # Each exclude is an upstream IstiN/crap4dart bug. Flip to
  # `severity: error` and drop the excludes when the upstream detector
  # fixes land — scripts/check_golden_detector.py re-verifies all six
  # classes against this exact detector (see its docstring).
  broken_goldens:
    enabled: true
    severity: warning
    dirs: [test/golden/goldens]
    exclude:
      # false positives: green checkmark tile reads as an X (light theme)
      - 'test/golden/goldens/launcher/grid_light.png'
      - 'test/golden/goldens/launcher/sheet_bar_light.png'
      - 'test/golden/goldens/launcher/sheet_bar_streaming_light.png…
